<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The '''Grand Elder's House''' (Elder Guru's house) is the home of [[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder Guru|Grand Elder Guru]] in the Sacred Land of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. The Grand Elder can unlock your potential beyond what the masters teach.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Grand Elder Guru|Grand Elder Guru]]''' offers '''Unlock Potential''': he raises your [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] skill from level 10 to 11 if your alignment is 50 or higher. Below 50 he greets you coldly. He teaches no skills.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
The house generates once per world, in the Sacred Land. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]] sells a '''Grand Elder's House Map''' for 1 Healing Bucket. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate elder_guru}} on Namek. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Like every master's home, the house can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] quest 18, ''Journey to the Grand Elder'': find the Grand Elder's House and talk to Grand Elder Guru.
</translate>
